description: This PHP source file defines the 'Extension' model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It contains methods to retrieve extension records, filter extensions by type, fetch specific extensions by code, and get installation records from the database, facilitating management of extensions within the system.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: A model class in the Opencart platform for managing extension data in the database.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all extension records from the database.

methods.name: getExtensionsByType
methods.description: Retrieves extension records filtered by a specific type.

methods.name: getExtensionByCode
methods.description: Fetches a specific extension record identified by its type and code.
